title: Preventing Trap Seal Loss in Unused Drains
description: P-traps rely on a continuous water barrier inside the dip to block sewer gases from entering indoor spaces. In fixture locations that remain unused for long periods—such as floor drains or basement utility sinks—this water seal slowly evaporates, leaving an open channel for dangerous foul odors and gases. A practical professional tip is to install an automatic trap primer or manually replenish dry traps regularly. For unoccupied properties, adding a small amount of non-toxic mineral oil helps slow evaporation by forming a protective layer over the water barrier.
